<DOCSTRING>
Determines if a person is an adult based on their age.

Checks if the person is 18 or older, which is the legal age for adulthood in many jurisdictions. This function is useful for validating user age in applications that require age-based access controls.

@constructor
@param {string} name - The name of the person.
@param {number} age - The age of the person.

@returns {boolean} True if the person is 18 or older, false otherwise.
</DOCSTRING>
